title: SAT Area & Volume: Formulas, Scale Factors, and Traps
description:
Most SAT area and volume formulas are on the reference sheet. The points get lost in how they're used: a diameter used as a radius, a scale factor applied the wrong way, mixed units, or a missing one third on a cone. This lesson covers all of it, then works through 6 SAT-style practice questions.

You'll learn:
• Every area and volume formula on the SAT reference sheet, and the pattern behind them
• Surface area vs. volume (surface area is NOT on the sheet)
• Shaded and composite regions: whole minus what's removed
• The scale factor rule: lengths × k, area × k², volume × k³
• Working backward from a volume to a missing length
• Filling and rate problems with unit conversions
• A 5-step test-day method

All questions are original SAT-style questions written for this video, not official College Board questions. For official practice, use the free SAT Suite Question Bank (Geometry and Trigonometry → Area and volume).
